capabilities.name: Land Cover Classification
capabilities.description: Classify land cover types (urban, forest, water, agriculture, barren, etc.) from multi-band satellite imagery using deep learning foundation models. Produces pixel-level classification maps.
known_limitations: Requires Prithvi foundation model fine-tuning for specific land cover schemes
Classification taxonomy must be defined per use case
Cloud cover in imagery reduces accuracy
capabilities.notes: Planned — requires fine-tuning the Prithvi-EO base model on a land cover classification dataset.
capabilities.verification_note: Architecture and schemas defined; pending specialist model deployment.

capabilities.name: Vegetation Analysis
capabilities.description: Analyze vegetation health, coverage, and dynamics using spectral indices (NDVI, NDWI, EVI, SAVI) computed from multi-band satellite imagery. Supports temporal change analysis.
known_limitations: Index-based analysis only — no deep learning classification
NDVI saturation in dense canopy areas
Cloud and shadow contamination affect accuracy
Atmospheric correction recommended for quantitative analysis
capabilities.notes: Algorithm-based implementation using standard spectral vegetation indices. No GPU or ML model required.
capabilities.verification_note: Mathematically verified algorithm implemented and tested.

capabilities.name: Flood Mapping
capabilities.description: Map flood extent from satellite imagery using the Prithvi-EO-2.0-300M model fine-tuned on the Sen1Floods11 dataset. Produces binary flood segmentation masks.
known_limitations: Requires Prithvi flood model to be downloaded and loaded
Binary classification only (flood vs. non-flood)
Cloud cover may obscure flood extent in optical imagery
SAR-based mapping not affected by clouds but has speckle noise
capabilities.notes: Planned — needs Prithvi flood model integration. Fallback to NDWI-based water detection is available as a simpler alternative.
capabilities.verification_note: Architecture and schemas defined; pending specialist model deployment.

capabilities.name: Burn Scar Detection
capabilities.description: Detect and map wildfire burn scars from satellite imagery using the Prithvi-EO-2.0-300M BurnScars model. Identifies post-fire damaged areas through semantic segmentation.
known_limitations: Detects post-fire burn scars only — not active fires
Requires cloud-free post-fire imagery
May confuse dark soil or recent plowing with burn scars
capabilities.notes: Planned — needs Prithvi burn scar model integration. NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) algorithm available as a fallback.
capabilities.verification_note: Architecture and schemas defined; pending specialist model deployment.

capabilities.name: Deforestation Detection
capabilities.description: Detect deforestation and forest degradation through multi-temporal satellite image analysis. Identifies areas of forest loss by comparing vegetation indices and land cover over time.
known_limitations: Requires multi-temporal imagery for change detection
Seasonal vegetation changes may cause false positives
Cloud cover limits temporal resolution in tropical regions
capabilities.notes: Planned — will combine NDVI temporal analysis with Prithvi model-based segmentation for robust deforestation mapping.
capabilities.verification_note: Architecture and schemas defined; pending specialist model deployment.

capabilities.name: Change Detection
capabilities.description: Detect and quantify surface changes between satellite images acquired at different times. Uses image differencing, ratio analysis, and spectral change vector analysis.
known_limitations: Algorithm-based — no semantic understanding of change type
Sensitive to radiometric differences between acquisitions
Co-registration accuracy affects results
Does not classify the type of change — only detects where change occurred
capabilities.notes: Algorithm-based implementation. Detects that change occurred but does not classify the nature of the change.
capabilities.verification_note: Mathematically verified algorithm implemented and tested.

capabilities.name: Biomass Analysis
capabilities.description: Estimate above-ground biomass and carbon stocks from satellite imagery using vegetation indices and allometric models. Supports forest carbon monitoring applications.
known_limitations: Biomass estimation from optical imagery has high uncertainty
Allometric models are region-specific
LiDAR data recommended for calibration but not always available
capabilities.notes: Planned — will combine spectral analysis with Prithvi features and allometric models for biomass estimation.
capabilities.verification_note: Architecture and schemas defined; pending specialist model deployment.

capabilities.name: Sea Surface Temperature Analysis
capabilities.description: Analyze sea surface temperature (SST) patterns, anomalies, and trends from satellite and in-situ ocean data. Supports ENSO monitoring, marine heatwave detection, and climate analysis.
known_limitations: Statistical analysis only — no ML-based prediction
Cloud cover affects satellite SST retrievals
In-situ data may have sparse spatial coverage
capabilities.notes: Algorithm-based statistical analysis of SST data. Includes climatology computation, anomaly detection, and trend fitting.
capabilities.verification_note: Mathematically verified algorithm implemented and tested.

capabilities.name: Salinity Analysis
capabilities.description: Analyze ocean salinity patterns from satellite and in-situ data (Argo floats, ship-based measurements). Supports water mass identification and freshwater flux estimation.
known_limitations: Satellite salinity measurements have lower resolution than SST
In-situ coverage is sparse in some ocean basins
Coastal salinity measurements affected by land contamination
capabilities.notes: Statistical analysis of salinity data from Argo floats and satellite retrievals.
capabilities.verification_note: Mathematically verified algorithm implemented and tested.

capabilities.name: Ocean Current Analysis
capabilities.description: Analyze ocean current patterns from altimetry-derived geostrophic currents, drifter data, and model outputs. Includes current velocity, eddy detection, and transport calculations.
known_limitations: Geostrophic currents do not capture Ekman or ageostrophic components
Altimetry-derived currents are surface-only
Temporal resolution limited by satellite revisit time
capabilities.notes: Algorithm-based analysis of ocean circulation patterns from satellite altimetry and model data.

capabilities.name: Sea Level Analysis

known_limitations: Altimetry accuracy limited near coastlines
Tide gauge records may have gaps and datum issues

capabilities.notes: Statistical analysis of sea level data from satellite altimetry and tide gauges.
capabilities.verification_note: Algorithmic heuristic implementation available; pending specialist satellite/sensor head integration.

capabilities.name: Chlorophyll Analysis
capabilities.description: Analyze ocean chlorophyll-a concentrations from satellite ocean color data. Supports phytoplankton bloom detection, primary productivity estimation, and marine ecosystem monitoring.
known_limitations: Satellite-derived chlorophyll affected by cloud cover
Algorithms may overestimate in turbid coastal waters
Limited depth penetration — surface values only
